name: NanoU
creator: NanoU
desc: Stream the locally attached computer to the official UU Remote app.

NANOU_UU_NAME.label: UU device name
NANOU_UU_NAME.description: Optional name displayed in UU Remote. Leave empty to keep the existing name.

NANOU_AUTOSTART.label: Start NanoU at boot
NANOU_AUTOSTART.description: Enter true or false. Open NanoU once on the touchscreen after changing this setting.

NANOU_AUDIO.label: Stream target audio
NANOU_AUDIO.description: Enter true or false. Requires NanoKVM Virtual Audio, MCP Service, and an MCP API key.

NANOU_KVM_MCP_KEY.label: Local NanoKVM MCP API key for audio

NANOU_MOUSE_SENSITIVITY.label: Relative mouse sensitivity (%)
NANOU_MOUSE_SENSITIVITY.description: 25–400. Absolute pointer mode keeps its screen coordinates.
